## ✅ Subtask 1-5 Completed Successfully!

I've successfully completed **subtask-1-5: Test responsive behavior across breakpoints** for the mobile navigation menu implementation.

### 🎯 What Was Implemented

**Key Enhancement:** Added automatic menu closing on window resize when transitioning from mobile to desktop viewport.

**Code Added** (lines 419-432 in `app/page.tsx`):
```typescript
// Close menu automatically when resizing to desktop view
useEffect(() => {
  const handleResize = () => {
    // 768px is the md: breakpoint in Tailwind
    if (window.innerWidth >= 768 && isMenuOpen) {
      setIsMenuOpen(false)
    }
  }

  window.addEventListener('resize', handleResize)
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('resize', handleResize)
  }
}, [isMenuOpen])
```
